# Syndicate Robo-Neuroticist
[color=#999999][italic]"Now where could my nuke core be?"[/italic][/color]
## Building Your Cyborgs Building your cyborgs are nearly identical to making normal ones, but differ in a few key areas.
Instead of normal cyborg endoskeletons, you'll be using [bold]syndicate cyborg endoskeletons[/bold], the assembly proccess is the same as a normal one, but they have a [color=cyan][bold]unique law 0 that makes them obey the SRN.[/color][/bold] This law can also be disabled by cutting the sync wire so be careful!
Syndicate neurolings are also used in the place of positronic brains, they are cheaper and have syndicate comms but are otherwise identical.
Another thing to consider is making [bold]syndicate identification chips[/bold] for your cyborgs, these come with syndicate access which is helpful for them to get around your ship, they also work like [color=cyan]agent cards[/color] and are capable of copying access.
## Expanding And Upgrading Your Army Eventually you will need brains for your cyborgs that aren't syndicate neurolings, this is where the artifact crusher on your ship comes in, it can be used to crush people into a brain which you can then place in an MMI like usual, [color=red]you may want to consider quickly putting them into one of your cyborgs as MMIs do have binary comms![/color]
Your exosuit fabricator is capable of making syndicate unique modules that can be placed into any type of borg and offer unique abilities. Some of these require materials you do not start with, you can steal these from the station.
Should you seek to convert the borgs on the station, you can unlock them with your robotics access and then use your [color=cyan]cryptographic sequencer[/color] on them once their maintenence pannel is open to make them obey you.
## Stealing The Plutonium Core Should you find youself tasked with stealing the plutonium core, make sure to not lose the screwdriver in your pocket, this is a special screwdriver that allows you to open the nuke. Once you have the nuke, use the screwdriver and follow the decontstruction steps.
[color=red]Make sure to put the plutonium core in your case quickly as it is [bold]EXTREMELY[/bold] radioactive![/color]
